description: List the countries where SendMyCall has virtual phone numbers, with their number types (local, national, mobile, toll-free...), the number of areas, the lowest monthly price in US cents and whether new numbers can be bought now. Optionally only countries with a given number type.

number_type.description: Kind of number: local, national, mobile, toll_free, shared_cost or global.

name: list_countries

area_count.description: Areas in the snapshot (of number_type when filtered). Not a stock count.

monthly_price_from_cents.description: Lowest monthly price in US cents, tax included; null when no price is published.

items.description: Kind of number: local, national, mobile, toll_free, shared_cost or global.

offered.description: Whether new numbers in this country can be bought now; null when that could not be checked.

order_url.description: The number picker for this country, where the user chooses and buys a number.

title: List countries
